name: Game of Life
shortDescription: Conway's cellular automaton — draw cells, load classic presets like the Gosper Glider Gun, and watch generations evolve on a toroidal grid.

generation.notes: Manual concept selection — select:app:suggestion failed on Node 20 due to missing WebSocket support for Supabase realtime. Visualizations was the most underrepresented category (2 apps). Grid uses Uint8Array double-buffering for performance. Toroidal wrap prevents edge stagnation. Default preset is Gosper Glider Gun as a showcase opener.
